tools_helpful.evidence: session-log turns 2-3: created MIGRATION-MAPPING.md, injected the picker TODO, and preserved the UWP project reference.
turns 4 and 8: returned focused picker and project/manifest guidance without loading the full pattern file.

tools_helpful.tool: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 and Windows Application event log
tools_helpful.evidence: turns 25-26 and 35: distinguished a registered startup crash and exposed COMException 0x8001010E at Application.Start/Program.Main.
turns 31 and 34: caught UWP residue, build failures, and repeated startup crashes.

tools_problematic.problem: Copied only files physically under the project directory and omitted csproj-linked shared shell, styles, code, and assets.
tools_problematic.evidence: turn 2 reported 4 copied files; turns 7-12 manually discovered and copied SharedContent items referenced through <Link> metadata.

tools_problematic.problem: Accepted an invalid/inconclusive package launch as PASS and did not validate the WinUI application entry point or capability element order.
tools_problematic.evidence: turn 22 passed despite manifest schema error; turn 40 passed after an unavailable user-mapped resources.pri launch; scoring later failed activation with Arg_COMException.

tool_limitations.limitation: Its structured crash result included exception type/message but not the event 1026 stack, so the agent had to query Get-WinEvent separately to see Program.Main.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Preserve the full event 1026 stack in diagnostics while keeping stdout concise.

tool_limitations.limitation: Running it from the parent app directory failed because no project existed there.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Always pass --project or run from the scaffolded project root.

failed_apis.root_cause: The migrated package retained a UWP-style Application EntryPoint instead of the WinUI scaffold's $targetentrypoint$ placeholder; validation did not reject it.
failed_apis.fix: Preserve EntryPoint="$targetentrypoint$" and make the validator fail any packaged WinUI application entry point with a different value.

doc_errors.wrong: A genuine deploy/environment failure was documented as a non-fatal WARN that still allowed validator PASS.
doc_errors.correct: An unavailable launch is inconclusive and cannot satisfy a mandatory launchability gate.

doc_errors.wrong: The checklist required runFullTrust but did not state AppX schema ordering among Capability, rescap:Capability, and DeviceCapability.
doc_errors.correct: Ordinary and restricted capabilities must precede DeviceCapability elements.

special_apis.special_handling: Initialize the picker with the WinUI window HWND before PickSingleFileAsync.
The API is hardware-dependent; preserve a visible status path when GetDefault returns null.
Keep the WinUI $targetentrypoint$ placeholder and schema-significant capability ordering.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The bootstrap and self-check were launched in parallel, so the check raced file creation.
errors_encountered.fix: Run bootstrap and then the self-check sequentially; the recheck returned True.

errors_encountered.error: dotnet run: Couldn't find a project to run.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Command ran from the parent app directory.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246 MainPage, CS0103 App, WMC0909 local:Scenario, WMC1111, WMC9999.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Linked shared shell files were omitted, then manually reconstructed with namespaces that did not match the scaffold and a compiled binding that failed type resolution.
errors_encountered.fix: Reconcile namespaces/usings and replace the failing template x:Bind with Binding; the general prevention is to copy evaluated linked project items during bootstrap.

errors_encountered.error: CS9035 required Scenario members from generated XamlTypeInfo.g.cs.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent added C# required members to a XAML-activated model type.
errors_encountered.fix: Use non-null default initializers instead of required on XAML-created types.

errors_encountered.root_cause: AppX manifest capability children were in schema-invalid order.
errors_encountered.fix: Place ordinary and restricted capabilities before all DeviceCapability elements.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The UWP-style manifest application entry point remained, while the validator checked only Desktop target and runFullTrust.
errors_encountered.fix: Restore EntryPoint="$targetentrypoint$" and validate it mechanically.

errors_encountered.error: resources.pri had a user-mapped section open.
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet run and the validator's build/launch were started concurrently against the same output.
errors_encountered.fix: Run build/launch gates sequentially and never treat an unavailable launch as proof of success.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Searched a large SharedContent tree and manually copied/recreated shell files, styles, and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap ignored external items linked by the legacy csproj.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent found the linked files from csproj references and copied them manually.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to resolve Include + Link items and stop on unresolved links.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Multiple compile/XAML retries for namespace, binding, nullability, and required-member errors.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manual shell reconstruction introduced inconsistent namespaces and XAML model constraints.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Added usings, changed x:Bind to Binding, and replaced required properties with defaults.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Copy linked source verbatim during bootstrap so the normal namespace rewrite and TODO inventory operate on the complete source.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Validator first passed an invalid manifest, then launch failed registration.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Validator checked capability presence but not AppX schema ordering.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add a manifest capability-order check to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated startup crashes led to unrelated namespace/resource/bootstrap-property edits and ended with an unavailable launch reported as PASS.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The validator omitted the required WinUI application entry-point check and allowed an inconclusive launch to pass.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the migration trial; the scorer reproduced Arg_COMException.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Validate EntryPoint="$targetentrypoint$" and fail the mandatory gate whenever launch status is unavailable.

missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Manual SharedContent discovery, shell reconstruction, asset copying, and several derivative compile errors.
The registration-order retry and the unresolved UWP entry-point activation failure.

env_issues.workaround: Serialize dotnet run, Test-AppLaunch, and Validate-UwpMigration invocations.
